description: This Java class 'SettingsManager' manages application settings including loading from and saving to an XML file, with fallback to defaults if the file is missing or damaged.

classes.name: SettingsManager
classes.description: A utility class for managing application settings, including loading from and saving to an XML configuration file.

methods.name: getSettings
methods.description: Returns the current Settings object, loading it if necessary.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads settings from an XML file, with fallback to default settings if the file is missing or corrupted.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves the provided Settings object to the configuration file, using a default progress pane.
